import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create an in-memory DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 75000.0]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to the start for reading
buffer.seek(0)

# Deserialize from the buffer back into a DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
assert df_original.frame_equal(df_restored), "Round trip failed: DataFrames are not equal"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful: Original and restored DataFrames are identical")
